definitions.gloss: being enrolled in school, attending school
definitions.explanation: The state of being registered as a student at an educational institution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{在学|ざいがく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{在学|ざいがく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I worked part-time while I was in school.

examples.japanese: {在学|ざいがく}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a certificate of enrollment issued.

notes:
A compound of {在|ざい} (being at) and ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (school/study). Refers to the state of being enrolled at an educational institution. Formal in register.

COMPOUNDS:
- {在学|ざいがく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→中：09840_chuu⟧: while enrolled in school
- {在学|ざいがく}{生|せい}: current student
- {在学|ざいがく}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧: certificate of enrollment
- {在学|ざいがく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: period of enrollment
- {在学|ざいがく}⟦{年数|ねんすう}→年数：23485_nensuu⟧: number of years enrolled

ASPECT (ている):
- {在学|ざいがく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to be currently enrolled (ongoing state)
- Used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the institution: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{在学|ざいがく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧: being registered/enrolled (broader — also used for companies and organizations)
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧: commuting to school (the physical act of going)
- ⟦{休学|きゅうがく}→休学：05140_kyuugaku⟧: leave of absence from school
